name: Icon
description: A generic icon wrapper that sizes and colors SVG icons consistently. Accepts an SVG as children and applies standardised dimensions and colour via tokens.

accessibility.role: img (when title is provided), presentation (when decorative)
notes: When a title prop is provided, the wrapper has role='img' and aria-label set to the title for screen readers.
When no title is provided, the icon is treated as decorative with aria-hidden='true'.
Do not use Icon for interactive purposes — wrap it in a Button or Link instead.

size.description: Controls the rendered size of the icon.

color.description: CSS custom property name (without '--') for the icon colour. Must be a valid colour token.

title.description: Accessible label for the icon. When provided, the icon is announced by screen readers.

children.description: The SVG element to render inside the icon wrapper.

do: Always provide a title when the icon conveys meaning.
Omit title for purely decorative icons so they are hidden from assistive technology.
Use colour tokens from the design system to maintain consistency.
dont: Do not use Icon as a clickable element — wrap it in a Button or Link.
Do not set width or height directly on the SVG child — let the Icon wrapper control sizing.
Do not pass raw hex values to the color prop — use a token name.
